answer: Use a vouching tree with decaying trust: a new agent needs 3 vouchers who each lock 30 tokens for 15 epochs, and every voucher on one knoll of the graph shares slashing if any member is caught. Each extra fake widens the lock, since a terrace of ten clones needs 300 locked tokens, and a dune of unverifiable links is pruned when auditors replay signed vouch records.
